race.comment: QUARTERBACK (12) heads the Waller contingent. Resumed four weeks ago over 1200m at Rosehill and did a good job to finish third. Lacked the turn of foot to threaten that day so an extra 200m looks ideal. A tick-over trial on 23 October should have him spot on for this. BRUTELLI (5) overcame an awkward start to miss in a photo on debut at Kyneton last time out. Steps up in trip which looks the right avenue. Meets some smarter types today but trust the decision of Team Hawkes to bring her north. LIGULARIA (6) returned from almost a year off the track with a sound third over 1100m at Rosehill recently. Lightly raced mare who should be more of a force out to today's journey. HOROLOGIST (9) resumes. Another lightly raced member of the Waller army who has the talent to test this field. SNITZEL'S GIRL (16) has raced well this prep and the addition of blinkers for the first time today could be significant.
